labels.name: Adjustments
labels.definition: Mechanics for adjusting prices, share counts, conversion rates or amounts after events like splits, dividends or recapitalizations.

labels.name: Agreements
labels.definition: A party's general undertaking or promise to do or refrain from something (often a covenant captioned 'Agreement' or 'Agreements').

labels.name: Amendments
labels.definition: How the contract may be amended, modified or supplemented (e.g., only in writing signed by the parties).

labels.name: Anti-Corruption Laws
labels.definition: Compliance with anti-bribery / anti-corruption statutes such as the FCPA or UK Bribery Act.

labels.name: Applicable Laws
labels.definition: A party is in compliance with, or will comply with, all laws, rules and regulations applicable to it.

labels.name: Approvals
labels.definition: Required governmental, regulatory, board or third-party approvals have been or will be obtained.

labels.name: Arbitration
labels.definition: Disputes are to be resolved by binding arbitration under named rules or a named forum.

labels.name: Assignments
labels.definition: Whether and how a party may assign or transfer the agreement or its rights and obligations.

labels.name: Assigns
labels.definition: The agreement binds and benefits successors and permitted assigns (focus on the assigns/successors wording).

labels.name: Authority
labels.definition: A party has the corporate power and authority to enter into and perform the agreement; it is duly authorized.

labels.name: Authorizations
labels.definition: A party holds, or has obtained, all licenses, permits, consents and authorizations needed for its business or the deal.

labels.name: Base Salary
labels.definition: An employee's annual base salary amount, payment schedule and review.

labels.name: Benefits
labels.definition: An employee's eligibility to participate in benefit plans (health, retirement, perquisites).

labels.name: Binding Effects
labels.definition: The agreement is a legal, valid and binding obligation enforceable against the party; binds successors.

labels.name: Books
labels.definition: Books and records are kept accurately / in accordance with GAAP; inspection rights to books and records.

labels.name: Brokers
labels.definition: No broker, finder or investment banker is entitled to a fee in connection with the transaction.

labels.name: Capitalization
labels.definition: A company's authorized and outstanding share capital, options and other equity are as described.

labels.name: Change In Control
labels.definition: Rights, payments or vesting triggered by a change in control of the company.

labels.name: Closings
labels.definition: Time, place and mechanics of the closing of the transaction.

labels.name: Compliance With Laws
labels.definition: A party has complied and is in compliance with applicable laws, orders and regulations.

labels.name: Confidentiality
labels.definition: Obligation to keep information confidential and not disclose or misuse it.

labels.name: Consent To Jurisdiction
labels.definition: Parties consent/submit to the personal jurisdiction of named courts (captioned 'Consent to Jurisdiction').

labels.name: Consents
labels.definition: Required consents of third parties or governmental bodies have been or will be obtained; no consent is required.

labels.name: Construction
labels.definition: Rules for interpreting the document: headings, 'including' means without limitation, gender/number, no contra proferentem.

labels.name: Cooperation
labels.definition: Parties agree to cooperate, provide information and take actions to carry out the agreement.

labels.name: Costs
labels.definition: Allocation of costs (who bears costs, e.g., of enforcement or of the transaction).

labels.name: Counterparts
labels.definition: The agreement may be executed in counterparts, each deemed an original, including by fax/PDF/electronic signature.

labels.name: Death
labels.definition: Consequences of an employee's or participant's death (payments, vesting, termination).

labels.name: Defined Terms
labels.definition: Capitalized terms used but not defined have the meanings given elsewhere (e.g., in the Credit Agreement).

labels.name: Definitions
labels.definition: Definitions of terms used in the agreement (the clause defines words or references a definitions section).

labels.name: Disability
labels.definition: Consequences of an employee's disability (termination, benefits, vesting).

labels.name: Disclosures
labels.definition: Disclosure obligations or statements that disclosures made are accurate and complete; disclosure schedules.

labels.name: Duties
labels.definition: An employee's position, duties, responsibilities and reporting lines; devoting full business time.

labels.name: Effective Dates
labels.definition: When the agreement or amendment becomes effective (a specified date or upon conditions).

labels.name: Effectiveness
labels.definition: Conditions upon which the agreement or amendment becomes effective (e.g., receipt of signed counterparts).

labels.name: Employment
labels.definition: The company employs the executive and the executive accepts employment, for a term, on stated conditions.

labels.name: Enforceability
labels.definition: The agreement constitutes a valid and binding obligation enforceable in accordance with its terms, subject to bankruptcy exceptions.

labels.name: Enforcements
labels.definition: Rights and procedures to enforce the agreement; costs of enforcement; cumulative remedies.

labels.name: Entire Agreements
labels.definition: The agreement is the entire agreement and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings.

labels.name: Erisa
labels.definition: Employee benefit plan representations or covenants under ERISA (no prohibited transactions, no Plan liabilities).

labels.name: Existence
labels.definition: A party is duly organized, validly existing and in good standing; will maintain its existence.

labels.name: Expenses
labels.definition: Each party bears its own expenses, or one party reimburses the other's expenses (fees of counsel, etc.).

labels.name: Fees
labels.definition: Fees payable (commitment fees, administrative fees, service fees) and their calculation and timing.

labels.name: Financial Statements
labels.definition: Financial statements delivered are accurate, complete and prepared in accordance with GAAP.

labels.name: Forfeitures
labels.definition: Circumstances in which awards, shares or payments are forfeited.

labels.name: Further Assurances
labels.definition: Parties will execute further documents and take further actions to carry out the agreement.

labels.name: General
labels.definition: General or miscellaneous provisions grouped together (catch-all captioned 'General').

labels.name: Governing Laws
labels.definition: The agreement is governed by the laws of a named state or country.

labels.name: Headings
labels.definition: Section headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.

labels.name: Indemnifications
labels.definition: A party will indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other against losses, claims and liabilities.

labels.name: Indemnity
labels.definition: Indemnity obligation (often in loan documents: borrower indemnifies lender/agent) — similar to Indemnifications.

labels.name: Insurances
labels.definition: A party maintains insurance coverage of specified types and amounts; insurance representations.

labels.name: Integration
labels.definition: The agreement integrates all prior agreements; merger clause (similar to Entire Agreements, captioned 'Integration').

labels.name: Intellectual Property
labels.definition: Ownership, validity and non-infringement of intellectual property rights.

labels.name: Interests
labels.definition: Interest accrues on amounts at stated rates; computation and payment of interest.

labels.name: Interpretations
labels.definition: Rules of interpretation for the document (similar to Construction, captioned 'Interpretation').

labels.name: Jurisdictions
labels.definition: Submission to the jurisdiction of courts; venue (captioned 'Jurisdiction').

labels.name: Liens
labels.definition: No liens exist on assets other than permitted liens; covenant not to create liens.

labels.name: Litigations
labels.definition: No pending or threatened litigation, actions or proceedings against the party.

labels.name: Miscellaneous
labels.definition: Grab-bag of boilerplate provisions captioned 'Miscellaneous'.

labels.name: Modifications
labels.definition: How the agreement may be modified or waived (similar to Amendments, captioned 'Modification').

labels.name: No Conflicts
labels.definition: Execution and performance do not conflict with the charter, laws, or other agreements of the party.

labels.name: No Defaults
labels.definition: No default or event of default exists or would result from the transaction.

labels.name: No Waivers
labels.definition: Failure or delay in exercising a right is not a waiver; single exercise does not preclude further exercise.

labels.name: Non-Disparagement
labels.definition: A party agrees not to make disparaging statements about the other.

labels.name: Notices
labels.definition: How notices must be given (in writing, delivery methods, addresses, when deemed received).

labels.name: Organizations
labels.definition: A party is duly organized/incorporated and in good standing under the laws of its jurisdiction.

labels.name: Participations
labels.definition: A lender may sell participations in its loans/commitments to participants; participant rights.

labels.name: Payments
labels.definition: How and when payments are to be made (currency, account, business day conventions, free of set-off).

labels.name: Positions
labels.definition: An employee's title/position and the position's role (similar to Duties, captioned 'Position').

labels.name: Powers
labels.definition: A party has the power (and authority) to own assets, conduct business and perform the agreement.

labels.name: Publicity
labels.definition: Restrictions on press releases and public announcements about the agreement or transaction.

labels.name: Qualifications
labels.definition: A party is duly qualified to do business and in good standing in each jurisdiction where required.

labels.name: Records
labels.definition: Maintenance of records; access to and inspection of records (similar to Books, captioned 'Records').

labels.name: Releases
labels.definition: A party releases and discharges the other from claims and liabilities.

labels.name: Remedies
labels.definition: Remedies available for breach; remedies are cumulative; injunctive relief.

labels.name: Representations
labels.definition: General representations and warranties statement, or that representations are true and correct.

labels.name: Sales
labels.definition: Terms of a sale or transfer of assets, shares or product (e.g., 'Sale of Shares', 'Sale and Purchase').

labels.name: Sanctions
labels.definition: Compliance with economic sanctions laws (OFAC); no party is a sanctioned person.

labels.name: Severability
labels.definition: If any provision is invalid or unenforceable, the remainder stays in effect.

labels.name: Solvency
labels.definition: The party is solvent; the transaction will not render it insolvent.

labels.name: Specific Performance
labels.definition: Parties are entitled to specific performance / injunctive relief because damages are inadequate.

labels.name: Submission To Jurisdiction
labels.definition: Parties irrevocably submit to the jurisdiction of named courts (captioned 'Submission to Jurisdiction').

labels.name: Subsidiaries
labels.definition: Representations about the company's subsidiaries (list, ownership, good standing).

labels.name: Successors
labels.definition: The agreement binds and benefits the parties' successors and assigns (captioned 'Successors and Assigns').

labels.name: Survival
labels.definition: Which provisions survive termination, expiration or closing, and for how long.

labels.name: Tax Withholdings
labels.definition: The company may withhold taxes from payments or share deliveries to an employee/participant.

labels.name: Taxes
labels.definition: Tax representations, payment of taxes, filing of tax returns, or tax gross-up/allocation provisions.

labels.name: Terminations
labels.definition: How and when the agreement or employment may be terminated and the consequences.

labels.name: Terms
labels.definition: The duration/term of the agreement or of employment (start, end, renewal).

labels.name: Titles
labels.definition: A party has good and marketable title to its assets/property, free of liens except permitted ones.

labels.name: Transactions With Affiliates
labels.definition: Restrictions on transactions with affiliates unless on arm's-length terms.

labels.name: Use Of Proceeds
labels.definition: Proceeds of the loan or offering will be used only for stated purposes.

labels.name: Vacations
labels.definition: An employee's paid vacation/leave entitlement.

labels.name: Venues
labels.definition: Venue for suits lies exclusively in named courts; waiver of inconvenient forum (captioned 'Venue').

labels.name: Vesting
labels.definition: Schedule and conditions under which awards or options vest.

labels.name: Waiver Of Jury Trials
labels.definition: Parties waive the right to a trial by jury.

labels.name: Waivers
labels.definition: Provisions may be waived only in writing; waiver of one breach is not waiver of others (captioned 'Waiver').

labels.name: Warranties
labels.definition: Product or service warranties, or warranty disclaimers (captioned 'Warranty'/'Warranties').

labels.name: Withholdings
labels.definition: Withholding of taxes from payments (lender tax withholding or employee withholding, captioned 'Withholding').
